evidence_scope: 576-message historical HR mailbox archive, interpreted alongside existing safe RTEC HR knowledge sources

observations.claim: HR operates as a cross-functional administrative hub rather than an isolated recruiting function.
observations.basis: Repeated email workflows connect HR with executive leadership, finance/IT, operations, procurement, training/compliance, benefits vendors, payroll/HRIS vendors and state reporting portals.

observations.claim: RTEC relies on a mix of internal staff, external brokers/carriers/vendors and government portals for HR administration.
observations.basis: Longitudinal correspondence across ADP, Guardian, CVIM, iSolved/Infinisource, UHC and Kentucky reporting systems.

observations.claim: Compliance/reporting is a recurring organizational burden.
observations.basis: Repeated EEO-1, AAP, contract-compliance, state-certification, unemployment, new-hire and benefit-reporting correspondence.

observations.claim: Operational knowledge has historically been distributed across email reminders, spreadsheets/forms, vendor portals, websites and individual staff handoffs.
observations.basis: 122 informal task-reminder messages plus recurring document, website, payroll and reporting coordination.

observations.claim: RTEC's HR technology stack has changed over time and currently appears layered.
observations.basis: System/vendor timeline from 2016-2026; no evidence supports collapsing all domains into one current system of record.

observations.claim: Historical HR work frequently depends on coordination with executive leadership and finance/IT before completion.
observations.basis: Repeated routing/follow-up patterns involving executive, controller/IT and administrative roles.

operational_risks_exposed_by_email_archi: Institutional knowledge can be lost when recurring work exists only as personal reminders or mailbox history.
System-of-record ambiguity can cause duplicate entry or uncertainty about which vendor owns a process.
Historical instructions can be mistaken for current procedure unless date/currentness is attached.
Manual deadline and follow-up tracking creates avoidable continuity risk when HR responsibility changes hands.
automation_implications: Convert recurring historical reminders into explicit candidate workflows and checklists before automating them.
Map authoritative system ownership by HR data domain before enabling write actions.
Use provenance and currentness gates for policy/compliance guidance.
Preserve professional handoff relationships as role-based knowledge so processes survive staff turnover.
